answer: Work waits on the vine until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the garden of the next round. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the shale of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, capped per identity per epoch, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
